inspiration.observed_pattern: A MySQL function catalog documents TIMESTAMPADD as a signed interval operation over a time point, with units including day, week, month, quarter, and year.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Rewritten as an independently authored billing-window report. Fixed invoice anchors apply month, day, and year offsets, including a leap-day year transition and a NULL timestamp; the source catalog schema, rows, and values are not copied.

fixture_notes: Invoice 201 starts on January 31 and exercises month-end clamping; invoice 202 starts on leap day and exercises year rollover; invoice 203 applies a negative day offset; invoice 204 preserves NULL input.
determinism_notes: Invoice IDs and timestamps are fixed, and output is ordered by the primary key with no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent connections.
setup: CREATE TABLE billing_windows (invoice_id INT PRIMARY KEY, base_at DATETIME NULL, month_shift INT NOT NULL, day_shift INT NOT NULL, year_shift INT NOT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT invoice_id, base_at, TIMESTAMPADD(MONTH, month_shift, base_at) AS month_window, TIMESTAMPADD(DAY, day_shift, base_at) AS day_window, TIMESTAMPADD(YEAR, year_shift, base_at) AS year_window FROM billing_windows ORDER BY invoice_id

checks.sql: SELECT invoice_id, base_at, month_shift, day_shift, year_shift FROM billing_windows ORDER BY invoice_id
